{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
duplicate_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Count how many unique patients there are
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Count how many patients have severe baseline disease
severe_count = df['severity'].eq('severe').sum()

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = severe_count / unique_patients

# Print results
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patients: {unique_patients}")
print(f"Duplicate patient rows: {duplicate_count}")
print(f"Number of patients with severe baseline disease: {severe_count}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
